archive_name.description: The main PAR2 archive name. Required for create mode.

block_count.description: Set the Block-Count. Mutually exclusive with block_size.

block_size.description: Set the Block-Size in bytes. Mutually exclusive with block_count.

redundancy_percent.description: Level of redundancy as a percentage.

redundancy_size.description: Redundancy target size (e.g., '100k', '10m', '1g'). Overrides redundancy_percent if set.

recovery_block_count.description: Recovery block count. Mutually exclusive with redundancy_percent/size.

first_recovery_block_number.description: First Recovery-Block-Number for adding additional recovery data.

uniform_recovery_files.description: Use uniform recovery file sizes. Mutually exclusive with limit_recovery_size.

limit_recovery_size.description: Limit size of recovery files. Mutually exclusive with uniform_recovery_files.

recovery_file_count.description: Number of recovery files. Mutually exclusive with limit_recovery_size.

threads_main.description: Number of threads for main processing. Empty for auto-detect.

threads_parallel.description: Number of files hashed in parallel.

purge_files.description: Purge backup and par files on successful recovery.

data_skipping.description: Enable data skipping to find badly mispositioned blocks.

skip_leaway.description: Skip leaway distance (+/-) from expected block position.

basepath.description: Basepath to use as reference for datafiles.

target_file.description: The PAR2 file or data file to operate on.
